title: United for Palestine march against Republic of Cyprus policy toward Israel
location: Nicosia city centre; began at Eleftheria Square and proceeded along commercial streets

occurrence.value: Cyprus Mail reports a Saturday afternoon march in Nicosia on 21 Dec.

onset.value: The page date is Sat 21 Dec; gathering began at 14:30 in Eleftheria Square.

domestic_state_target.value: Chants addressed President “Niko”; speakers demanded an end to Cyprus’ support/ties with Israel, including the state’s military role.

episode.value: Distinct one-day march. Thematic recurrence with Oct 7 and Nov 24 demonstrations is possible, but continuous event or same episode is not established; no automatic merger.

open_questions: Independent review should check whether any contemporaneous article has a documented same-story origin and whether the CyprusMail report suffices on its own.
Assess possible thematic continuity with October/November marches; no uninterrupted episode or common campaign onset established.
Dialogos page for same event is retained but not used because origin may involve held Facebook content.

title: Turkish Cypriot union protest near northern administration’s leadership office (reported Dec 6)
location: Northern Nicosia; exact public location not specified in page body

participants_estimate.qualifier: 19 unions reported; not a participant count

occurrence.value: Article says 19 unions of public-sector workers protested on Friday, throwing potatoes at northern “prime minister” office; Friday before 9 Dec is 6 Dec.

onset.value: 6 Dec 2024 inferred from article published Monday 9 Dec and reference to previous Friday; reviewer should verify exact calendar date.

country_location.value: Northern Nicosia under Turkish Cypriot administration, not Republic-controlled city; exact place is not stated.

simultaneous_threshold.value: Unknown; 19 unions is not a crowd estimate.

domestic_state_target.value: Unions reacted to the northern administration’s planned changes to cost-of-living calculation and collective bargaining.

jurisdiction.value: Territorial jurisdiction and dataset country coding require separate reviewer decision; never combine with Nicosia/Republic-controlled events.

episode.value: Article describes continuing protests; onset and relation to Dec 9 planned action are unresolved.

open_questions: Does the unit’s Cyprus definition include events in the Turkish Cypriot administration area?
Was at least 50 present simultaneously at the Dec 6 protest?
Can an independent local Turkish-language source confirm date/location/size and separate Dec 6 from Dec 9?
